descriptions.d25c_resource_load_800fd504: Copy the name into a string with bit 1 of the flags cleared and bit 0 set. If the name has a dot, truncate the copy at it. If the copy has no dot, append .xom when flag 1 is set, else .xml when flag 2 is set. Call the loader service with the text, the argument and the low flag byte, destroy the string and return the result.
